introduction: Real production implementations, architectural blueprints, and interactive demonstrations spanning Computer Vision, MLOps, Infrastructure as Code, and Cloud Security.

projects.title: AI-Powered CCTV Surveillance & Intelligence Platform
projects.metaPill: YOLO · Jetson Orin Nano · ArcFace · SageMaker · pgvector
projects.summary: Multi-facility vision analytics platform: fine-tuned YOLO (mAP@0.5 ~82% to ~91%), 35–45 FPS edge inference on Jetson Orin Nano, ArcFace face recognition in PostgreSQL pgvector (HNSW), SageMaker endpoints, and LLM-based CCTV summarization.
projects.imageAlt: AI CCTV Surveillance & Vision Analytics Dashboard

projects.title: AWS IaaS Multi-Tenant Automation Using Terraform
projects.metaPill: Terraform · ECS Fargate · Aurora RDS · API Gateway · WAF
projects.summary: Production-grade modular Terraform infrastructure provisioning a multi-tenant cloud environment across isolated 3-tier VPC subnets, containerized ECS Fargate services, Aurora Serverless RDS, and automated CodePipeline CI/CD.

projects.title: HIPAA & SOC 2 Cloud Compliance & Zero-Trust Automation
projects.metaPill: Zero-Trust · SSM Tunneling · KMS · GuardDuty · 80% Score
projects.summary: Automated AWS security framework with Terraform embedding HIPAA & SOC 2 controls, eliminating public SSH/bastions via Systems Manager (SSM) ProxyCommand tunneling, KMS encryption, and achieving an 80% cloud security benchmark.

projects.title: AWS CodePipeline (CI/CD) with CloudFormation
projects.summary: Full CloudFormation infrastructure template and architectural design for an automated delivery pipeline: CodeCommit to CodeBuild to ECS container deployments with built-in rollback telemetry.

projects.title: Linear Regression From Scratch
projects.metaPill: Pure Python · NumPy · Gradient Descent · Cost Function
projects.summary: Algorithmic implementation of gradient descent optimization and cost function convergence without high-level ML frameworks, illustrating core mathematical foundations of predictive models.

projects.title: Interactive Regex Pattern Matcher
projects.summary: Full-featured regular expression playground and testing suite with live syntax analysis, flag customization (g, i, m, s), token breakdown, and rapid regex pattern templates.
